title: Flow: The Genius of Routine
coreMove: Design a default path that carries the essential action before distractions get a daily vote.
sourcePressure: The chapter presents routine as the structure that makes essential work the default and reduces repeated decision fatigue.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would write about morning routines or habit stacking without connecting routine to protected essential work.

hook: generic flow: the genius of routine topic opener
tryThisNow: set a timer for ninety seconds...
make a list of priorities without a trade-off
generic say no to one thing today

exampleSpecs.domain: surgical sterilization unit attaching tray check to the first instrument rack handoff
exampleSpecs.audience: unit lead making essential quality automatic
exampleSpecs.stakes: sterility checks fail when they depend on memory at the end
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She clips a clamp card to the first rack so the check happens before trays enter the washer.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A clamp card hangs from a sterile instrument rack.

exampleSpecs.domain: bakery scaling sourdough by linking starter check to flour-bin opening
exampleSpecs.audience: baker making the essential action the default
exampleSpecs.stakes: routine prevents rushed guessing later in the bake
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Before, starter checks are remembered late; after, the scale-zero tag on the flour bin triggers the check.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A scale-zero tag hangs from the flour bin handle.

exampleSpecs.domain: housing-assistance hotline attaching callback triage to the tax-map lookup
exampleSpecs.stakes: the default path should carry the essential resident call
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She places the offer tray with the tax map so triage happens before any file is opened.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: An offer tray sits beside a tax map and resident call sheet.

exampleSpecs.domain: metal foundry adding fiber-test strip to brass vat ignition key
exampleSpecs.audience: foundry supervisor preventing skipped safety tests
exampleSpecs.stakes: routine carries safety before production pressure starts
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: He clips the fiber-test strip to the ignition key so no pour can begin before the check.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A fiber-test strip is clipped to a brass vat ignition key.

exampleSpecs.domain: rare-book shipping room tying courier booking to locked drawer opening
exampleSpecs.stakes: shipping should not begin before condition proof exists
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She stores the rare-type pouch beside the courier clipboard so condition photos happen first.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A rare-type pouch sits in a locked drawer beside a courier clipboard.

exampleSpecs.domain: theater rigging crew attaching inspection tag to paint-key hook
exampleSpecs.stakes: the first handoff should force the essential inspection
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The rigging inspection tag hangs from the paint-key hook, so the first person unlocking scenery sees the check before color.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A rigging inspection tag hangs from a paint-key hook.
